title.narrative: Mitigating climate change through reforestation in the Grande Montagne and Anse Quitor Nature Reserves, Rodrigues

description.narrative: The proposed project is relevant to the Global Objective of this Call for Proposals: To increase local CSOs' capacity to perform their roles as independent development actors more effectively. The proposed project will allow the MWF, a national Civil Society Organisation, to strengthen its capacity to implement adaptation in the fields of Climate Change mitigation through reforestation, ecosystems restoration, biodiversity conservation, environmental protection, sustainable development, and Climate Change awareness. This will be done through an increased capacity in delivering Climate Change action, awareness raising, improving its infrastructure, equipment base and increasing its workforce
